name: check_room
description: Checks whether a room can be booked for a requested time slot and answers Available or Unavailable. All times are whole minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440 (10:00 is 600, 24:00 is 1440). It looks at the requested start and end, the current time, whether the room is blocked, and the existing bookings. It only checks: it does not save, create or change any booking, so calling it never reserves the room.

start.description: Requested start, in whole minutes since midnight (10:00 = 600).

end.description: Requested end, in whole minutes since midnight (24:00 = 1440).

now.description: The current time, in whole minutes since midnight.

blocked.description: true if the room is blocked (for example for maintenance), false if it is not.

bookings.description: Existing bookings of the room. Use an empty list if there are none.

start.description: Booking start, in whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Booking end, in whole minutes since midnight.
